about_the_game:
Blightspire is a fast-paced, wave-based survival shooter. Battle through a cursed graveyard as undead abominations rise in endless waves. With only your reflexes and firepower, survive the darkness in a world where death is never the end.

In a plague-stricken 17th-century, you’re a thief drawn to rumors of treasure buried in a cursed cemetery. As you rob the graves, the dead rise to defend what’s theirs. Fighting to survive, you uncover a demonic presence seeping from an ancient church altar, its influence twisting the dead and spreading corruption. Now, it’s not just about gold... it’s about stopping hell from breaking loose.

Survive relentless waves of the undead as the Black Death twists the once-living into monstrous horrors.

  • Dodge, dash, and leap through plague-ridden graveyards to avoid the infected swarms

  • Use your trusty revolver to blast through the twisted remains of humanity

  • Stay alive, and uncover the dark forces fueling the nightmare

The deeper you go, the stranger it gets.

  • Loot the fallen dead to fund powerful relics from a demonic source

  • Absorb their lingering souls to restore your health and keep fighting

Take advantage of the demonic presence in the graveyard and use the unholy relics to your advantage.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains assets depicting hanging corpses.

Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 6500, AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1050 TI, AMD Radeon RX 570
